page.layout: Two columns side by side on one printed page. Running head across the top of both columns, page number at top left. Left column: heading "ב ה" then nine entries. Right column: entries, then heading "ב ן" midway down, then one entry and a bare "m." at the foot.

main_text.head: ב ה
main_text.p: בְּהַבִּיט[?] in intueri me, Infin. Hiph. praef. aff. R. נָבַט.
בְּהָגִיגִי in meditatione mea, No. sing. m. praef. & aff. Rad. הָגָה meditari.
בְּהוּ inanitas, No. f. m. Rad. בָּהָה.
בְּהִוָּסְדָם[?] in consultando eos, Infin. Niph. praef. & aff. Rad. יָסַד fundavit.
בְּהַוּרָתָהּ[?] in pravitate sua, No. f. faem. הַוָּה praef. aff. Rad. הָוָה fuit.
בִּהְיוֹתוֹ in esse eum, Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. הָיָה.
בְּהַפְרֵת in excindendo, Inf. Niph. praef. R. כָּרַת.
בְּהַדְּגוֹ[?] in lucere facere ipsum, Job. 29.3. pro, בְּהַהֲלוֹ, Infin. Hiph. praef. aff. Rad. הָלַל.
בְּהַמִּיר in mutando, Inf. Hiph. praef. R. מוּר.
בְּהֶמְתָּם Jumentum eorum, f. f. constr. בְּהֶמַת, No. בְּהֵמָה, vel בְּהֶמֶת. Rad. inus. בהם.
בְּהַצְּתוֹ in certando ipsum, Infin. Hiph. praef. & aff. Rad. נָצָה.
בְּהִקָּבְּצוֹ[?] in congregando se, Inf. Niph. praef. R. קָבַץ.
בְּהַקִּיץ[?] in evigilando, Inf. Hiph. praef. R. קִיץ.
בְּהָרֵג in occidi, Ezech. 26. 15. pro, בְּהַהָרֵג, Infin. Niph. praef. Rad. הָרַג.
בְּהַשַּׁמָּה in desolari eam, Lev. 26. 43. pro, בְּהַשַּׁמָּה, vel pro, בְּהוּשַּׁמָּה Infin. Hoph. praef. aff. Rad. שָׁמַם.
בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ in judicari ipsum, Infin. Niph. praef. & aff. Rad. שָׁפַט.
main_text.head: ב ן
main_text.p: בּוֹרְאָם affingens ea, Neh. 6. 8. vel, בְּרִאם, pro בּוֹרְאָם, Ben. Kal, f. m.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing and some Hebrew forms in the scan are blurred; marked [?] where not certain. Page number "41" read from a faint mark at top left. The bare "m." at the foot of the right column is part of the last entry (gender abbreviation). Head "ב ה" at top of left column and "ב ן" midway in the right column are letter headings.
